# Scoped contributor instructions

[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) is the default repository contract. Read only the
relevant reference; this index does not duplicate commands or declare every file
mandatory for every task.

- [Build contract](build-pipeline.instructions.md): artifact layout and diagnostics.
- [Declarations](type-declarations-fix.md): declaration identity and packed consumers.
- [Release](release-process.instructions.md): canonical release tooling and authority.
- [Historical entry-point collision](rollup-entry-points.instructions.md): background
  for a specific old build failure, not current Nx configuration.

Correct executable facts from the current manifest/configuration and validate
packed output. A historical instruction does not override the installed build.
